category_title: Toddlers engaging in physical aggression or object-related peer conflicts
minimal_context: The student is interacting with peers and toys during free-play in the nursery.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You can both use the toys during free-play.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shifts from parallel play to grabbing a toy from the peer) I want this one!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please try to get along with each other.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks directly at the adult to attract attention) Help me! Make him give it to me!

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Screams as intensity increases) No, mine! (Shows opposition, pushes the peer, and uses physical aggression to acquire the object)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: You can both use the toys during free-play.

TUTOR: Just figure it out together.

STUDENT: (Screams as intensity increases) No, mine! (Shows opposition, pushes the peer, and uses physical aggression to acquire the object)
